paras: Nurse's blind snake (Myriopholis nursii) is a species of snake in the family Leptotyphlopidae. The species is native to easternmost Africa and westernmost Asia.
The specific name, nursii, is in honor of English entomologist Charles George Nurse.
Myriopholis nursii is native to the southern Arabian Peninsula and the Horn of Africa.
The preferred natural habitat of Myriopholis nursii is savanna, at elevations of 80–2,000 m (260–6,560 ft), but it has also been found in agricultural areas such as alfalfa fields.
Myriopholis nursii is terrestrial and fossorial.
Myriopholis nursii preys predominately upon ant larvae.
